description:
Elah is the King James Bible for iPhone, iPad and Mac. It opens on David and Goliath in the valley of Elah, and every chapter is on your device, so it works with or without a signal.

Read
Tap the reference at the top to jump to any book and chapter. Choose sans or serif, three line spacings and any text size. The house button always brings you back to 1 Samuel 17.

Listen
Your device reads any chapter aloud and outlines the verse it is on. Skip a verse, change the speed, and keep it playing with the screen off.

Keep
Press and hold a verse to highlight it in one of four colours, bookmark it, write a note, copy it, or share it as a text or an image card. Everything you mark waits in Saved, in canon order.

Search
Search every verse offline. Put words in quotes to find an exact phrase, and narrow it to the Old or New Testament.

Today
Pick up where you left off, or start with the verse of the day.

The NIV opens on BibleGateway.com, which holds its licence.

No account, no ads, no tracking. Your highlights and notes stay on your device.
promotionalText: The King James Bible, offline, opening on David and Goliath. Listen, highlight, write notes, search every verse.
